frequency_question: How often do announced high-stakes import duties proceed to implementation within the specified window versus being averted or withdrawn?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly threatened tariffs by major economies on key strategic sectors with defined short deadlines; excludes routine anti-dumping duties or long legislative tariff overhauls.
coverage_note: 6 named prominent instances representing modern presidential tariff threats
known_gaps: Does not exhaustively list minor sub-sector threats outside major geopolitical trade disputes.
skeleton: Threatened bilateral trade actions divided by outcome category
multiplier: 4 hits out of 6 major instances equals 66 percent base implementation frequency for high-level threats.
validity_reason: Executive trade enforcement norms remain stable across modern presidential administrations.
